name: PteroVM

description: noVNC desktop from one Java jar. The server port serves the desktop. The console prints the URL and the VNC password when it is ready. x86_64 only.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Fetches the PteroVM launcher. Does not delete the unpacked desktop.
set -eu
cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${SERVER_JARFILE:-}" ]; then
    SERVER_JARFILE=server.jar
fi

if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_URL:-}" ]; then
    echo "Downloading PteroVM"
    curl -fL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 15 -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}.partial" "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
    mv "${SERVER_JARFILE}.partial" "${SERVER_JARFILE}"
elif [ -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ]; then
    echo "Keeping the existing ${SERVER_JARFILE}"
else
    echo "No ${SERVER_JARFILE} and no download URL."
    echo "Upload pterovm.jar as ${SERVER_JARFILE}, or set a download URL and reinstall."
    exit 1
fi

echo "PteroVM jar is ready."

variables.description: Jar file Wings starts. Leave this as server.jar.

variables.name: Download URL
variables.description: Optional URL of pterovm.jar. Used only on install or reinstall. Leave blank to keep the jar already in the server files.

variables.name: VNC Password
variables.description: Desktop password, 8 characters or fewer. Leave blank to keep the saved password. The console prints the password in use.
